compose_transform_pipeline: create a Compose pipeline that chains RandomCrop, RandomHorizontalFlip, Resize, and Normalize transforms for object detection data augmentation
crop_image_with_target: crop a PIL image and its bounding box target dict to a specified region tuple
resize_image_with_boxes: resize a PIL image and scale its bounding box coordinates proportionally while preserving aspect ratio
normalize_and_normalize_boxes: normalize a PIL image with mean and std values and convert bounding boxes to normalized center format
random_select_transforms: create a RandomSelect transform that randomly chooses between two transform pipelines with configurable probability
